<!-- Cierre del contenedor card-container -->

```{=html}
<script>
    // GitHub
    fetch('https://api.github.com/users/fiorellaguillen')
    .then(response => response.json())
    .then(data => {
        document.getElementById('github-avatar').src = data.avatar_url;
        document.getElementById('github-name').textContent = data.name || data.login;
        document.getElementById('github-username').textContent = "@" + data.login;
        document.getElementById('github-bio').textContent = data.bio || "No bio available";
        document.getElementById('github-link').href = data.html_url;
        document.getElementById('github-profile-link').href = data.html_url;
    });

    // LinkedIn (estático)
    document.getElementById('linkedin-avatar').src = "https://media.licdn.com/dms/image/v2/D5603AQG2eh1cOz_Fpg/profile-displayphoto-shrink_400_400/B56ZU4S6xeHEAo-/0/1740406238917?e=1753315200&v=beta&t=RTY7gqTMHgd92WIA87uGp3QDm7DuS28HTU78Gwx_9AQ";
    document.getElementById('linkedin-name').textContent = "Roxana Fiorella Guillen Hurtado";
    document.getElementById('linkedin-username').textContent = "@fiorellaguillenh";
    document.getElementById('linkedin-bio').textContent = "MSc Urban Spatial Science 2024-25 | UCL";
    document.getElementById('linkedin-link').href = "https://www.linkedin.com/in/fiorellaguillenh/";
    document.getElementById('linkedin-profile-link').href = "https://www.linkedin.com/in/fiorellaguillenh/";
</script>
```

```{=html}
<style>
.card-container {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 20px;
    padding: 20px;
    /* Quité align-items para que no centre verticalmente */
    /* align-items: center; */
    min-height: auto; /* No queremos que el contenedor tenga altura fija */
}

.github-card, .linkedin-card {
    border: 1px solid #ddd;
    border-radius: 10px;
    width: 280px;
    min-height: 320px;   /* Altura mínima igual para ambas */
    font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
    padding: 15px;
    text-align: left;
    background-color: white;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    align-self: flex-start; /* Alineación arriba */
}

    .github-header, .linkedin-header {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: left;
        padding: 5px 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;
    }

    .github-header img#github-logo {
        width: 100px;
        height: auto;
    }

    .linkedin-header img#linkedin-logo {
        width: 80px;
        height: auto;
    }

    .github-body, .linkedin-body {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 10px 0;
    }

    .github-avatar, .linkedin-avatar {
        border-radius: 50%;
        height: 60px;
        width: 60px;
        margin-right: 10px;
    }

    .github-card h3, .linkedin-card h3 {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: 15px;
    }

    .github-card p, .linkedin-card p {
        margin: 5px 0;
        font-size: 14px;
        color: #555;
    }

    .github-button {
        display: block;
        text-align: center;
        text-decoration: none;
        color: #0366d6;
        padding: 6px;
        border: 2px solid #0366d6;
        border-radius: 6px;
        margin-top: 10px;
        font-weight: bold;
        background-color: white;
    }

    .github-button:hover {
        background-color: #0366d6;
        color: white;
    }

    .linkedin-button {
        display: block;
        text-align: center;
        text-decoration: none;
        color: #0a66c2;
        padding: 6px;
        border: 2px solid #0a66c2;
        border-radius: 6px;
        margin-top: 10px;
        font-weight: bold;
        background-color: white;
    }

    .linkedin-button:hover {
        background-color: #0a66c2;
        color: white;
    }
</style>
```
